_meta.role: Software Engineer III, AI/ML, AI and Infrastructure

summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY, with hands-on experience building and optimizing ML infrastructure in Python and C++. Built ASR pipelines from architecture through deployment, including a from scratch speech recognition model reaching 15% WER, and optimized inference through 8-bit quantization and TensorRT for up to 5.2x speedup. Debugged and resolved integration failures across distributed, multi-device ML systems end to end.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images achieving 83% mAP@50 on held out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 backbones; evaluated on Dice Score and IoU and reported accuracy latency trade offs for deployment.
Engineered a data processing pipeline for the BraTS 2020 multi modal MRI dataset with augmentation and batch loading memory management for large scale volumetric inputs.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Built preprocessing and training pipelines in PyTorch using HuggingFace to fine tune a document understanding transformer for structured field extraction.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% by debugging and iterating on preprocessing and model tuning.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI for real time data acquisition and experimental visualization in a laboratory environment.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) - MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated faster-whisper speech to text and TensorRT optimized YOLO (5.2x speedup, 17.6 to 92 FPS) for visual servoing across a Flutter, Flask-SocketIO, and Jetson plus Arduino pipeline linked by WebSocket.
Debugged and resolved 11 integration failures across the distributed system; reached 100% pick reliability over 10 trials at about 11.5s end to end latency.

projects.name: COFFIN - Whisper-Style ASR from Scratch
bullets: Built an end to end speech recognition pipeline: an 80 channel mel spectrogram encoder and a 4 block causal Transformer decoder with cross attention, trained on Indian-English audio samples.
Designed a custom BPE tokenizer with a Cython accelerated backend for 4 to 5.5x speedup over pure Python; reached 15% word error rate on a Hindi-English dataset.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by about 55% via 8-bit quantization on TinyLlama 1.1B; profiled peak VRAM and latency using pynvml, benchmarking accuracy across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC with under 1% degradation.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced TorchScript convolution layers with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing and constant memory, reaching about 35% speedup over naive GPU execution with identical classification accuracy.
